title: Proppant Embedment Test Data Schema
description: A proppant‑embedment test measures how far a proppant grain indents a rock surface under simulated downhole stresses, providing a proxy for loss of fracture conductivity due to grain embedment. The test links rock strength, stress state, and proppant hardness to predict embedment‑related conductivity loss.

LithologyDescription.title: Lithology Description
LithologyDescription.description: A description of the physical and chemical characteristics of the sample.

Temperature.title: Temperature
Temperature.description: The temperature at which the test was conducted.

ConfiningStress.title: Confining Stress
ConfiningStress.description: The pressure exerted on a sample from its environment during the test.

MinimumEmbedmentPressure.title: Minimum Embedment Pressure
MinimumEmbedmentPressure.description: Minimum pressure at which embedment begins.

FractureConductivity.title: Fracture Conductivity
FractureConductivity.description: The calculated fracture conductivity expressed as the absolute permeability times the proppant pack width.

ProppantAgent.title: Proppant Agent
ProppantAgent.description: Defines the proppant used in the experiment and its properties.

MassAbsorptionCoefficient.title: Mass Absorption Coefficient
MassAbsorptionCoefficient.description: Characterizes how easily radiation passes through a material. This can be used to compute the concentration of proppant in a slurry using a densitometer.

MeshSizeHigh.title: Mesh Size High
MeshSizeHigh.description: Integer high value of sieve mesh size: for 4070 sand, this value is 70. For a 70 sand this would be 70.

MeshSizeLow.title: Mesh Size Low
MeshSizeLow.description: Integer low value of sieve mesh size: for 4070 sand, this value is 40.

UnconfinedCompressiveStrength.title: Unconfined Compressive Strength
UnconfinedCompressiveStrength.description: The unconfined compressive strength of the proppant.

items.title: Stim ISO13503_2 Properties
items.description: ISO13503_2 properties for this proppant agent.

AbsoluteDensity.title: Absolute Density
AbsoluteDensity.description: The density the material would have if no intra-granular porosity is present. (e.g. Boyle's Law porosimetry).

AcidSolubility.title: Acid Solubility
AcidSolubility.description: The solubility of a proppant in 12:3 HCl:HF for 30 minutes at 150°F is an indication of the amount of soluble materials (i.e. carbonates, feldspars, iron oxides, clays, etc) present in the proppant.

ApparentDensity.title: Apparent Density
ApparentDensity.description: Apparent density excludes extra-granular porosity by placing a known mass in a volume of fluid and determining how much of the fluid is displaced (Archimedes).

BulkDensity.title: Bulk Density
BulkDensity.description: Bulk density includes both the proppant and the porosity. This is measured by filling a known volume with dry proppant and measuring the weight.

ClustersPercent.title: Clusters Percent
ClustersPercent.description: Percentage of undesirable agglomerated discrete proppant particles which typically occurs more with inefficiently processed natural sand proppants as opposed to manufactured ceramic proppants. ISO 13503-2 and API RP19C limit the mass of clusters to less than 1%.

items.title: ISO13503_2 Crush Test Data
items.description: ISO13503_2 crush test data for this instance of ISO13503_2 data for the proppant agent.

Fines.title: Fines
Fines.description: Mass percentage of fines after being exposed to stress.

Stress.title: Stress
Stress.description: Stress measured at a point during a crush test.

KValue.title: K Value
KValue.description: Crush test classification indicating the highest stress level at which a proppant generated no more than 10% crushed material rounded down to the nearest 1,000 psi during a crush test. For example, a value of 14 means 14k which is 14000 psi.

LossOnIgnition.title: Loss On Ignition
LossOnIgnition.description: A mass loss (gravimetric) test method applied to coated proppants only, which determines the mass of resin coating applied to a natural sand or manufactured proppant by means of thorough combustion of the flammable resin from the nonflammable proppant. Reported as a % of original mass.

MeanParticleDiameter.title: Mean Particle Diameter
MeanParticleDiameter.description: The mean diameter of particles in a sample of proppant.

MedianParticleDiameter.title: Median Particle Diameter
MedianParticleDiameter.description: The median diameter of particles in a sample of proppant.

Roundness.title: Roundness
Roundness.description: Krumbein Roundness Shape Factor that is a measure of the relative sharpness of grain corners or of grain curvature. Krumbein and Sloss (1963) are the most widely used method of determining shape factors.

items.title: ISO13503_2 Sieve Analysis Data
items.description: ISO13503_2 sieve analysis data for this instance of ISO13503_2 data for the proppant agent.

PercentRetained.title: Percent Retained
PercentRetained.description: The percentage of mass retained in the sieve.

SieveNumber.title: Sieve Number
SieveNumber.description: ASTM US Standard Mesh opening size used in the sieve analysis test. To indicate Pan, use 0.

SpecificGravity.title: Specific Gravity
SpecificGravity.description: Not formally part of ISO 13503.2 properties, the specific gravity is the apparent density of the proppant divided by the density of water.

Sphericity.title: Sphericity
Sphericity.description: Krumbein Sphericity Shape Factor that is a measure of how closely a proppant particle approaches the shape of a sphere. Krumbein and Sloss (1963) are the most widely used method of determining shape factors.

TurbidityNTU.title: Turbidity NTU
TurbidityNTU.description: A measure of water clarity, how much the material suspended in water decreases the passage of light through the water.   Measured according to USEPA 180.1 and expressed in Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU).

TurbidityFNU.title: Turbidity FNU
TurbidityFNU.description: A measure of water clarity, how much the material suspended in water decreases the passage of light through the water. Measured according to ISO 7027 and expressed in Formazin Nephelometric Units (FNU).

items.title: ISO13503_5 properties for this proppant agent.
items.description: ISO13503_5 point properties for this proppant agent.

Temperature.title: Temperature
Temperature.description: The temperature at the time measurements were taken.

SupplierName.title: Supplier Name
SupplierName.description: The name of the proppant supplier.

SupplierID.title: Supplier ID
SupplierID.description: Identifier of service company organisation providing this proppant agent for the stimulation job.

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description: General remarks about this proppant agent.

ProppantLoad.title: Proppant Load
ProppantLoad.description: Mass of proppant loaded per sample area.

ProppantLayers.title: Proppant Layers
ProppantLayers.description: The number of discrete proppant beds or layers placed against the rock surface.

TestFluid.title: Test Fluid
TestFluid.description: Fluid used for sample saturation and circulation during the embedment test.

AverageEmbedmentDepthAtClosure.title: Average Embedment Depth At Closure
AverageEmbedmentDepthAtClosure.description: Average depth of proppant indentation across the sample surface measured after the applied stress is equal to the fracture‑closure stress.

StepNumber.title: Step Number
StepNumber.description: Internal step number which identifies the repeated steps in this analysis.

ElapsedTime.title: Elapsed Time
ElapsedTime.description: Elapsed time since the start of the experiment.

AxialPistonPumpPressure.title: Axial Piston Pump Pressure
AxialPistonPumpPressure.description: Instantaneous pressure generated by the axial piston pump that drives the loading system

AxialPistonDisplacement.title: Axial Piston Displacement
AxialPistonDisplacement.description: Reading from the Linear Variable Differential Transformer (LVDT) that measures the relative axial displacement of the loading piston (or platen) with respect to a fixed reference point.

AxialStress.title: Axial Stress
AxialStress.description: Calculated axial stress acting on the rock specimen.

AxialDisplacement.title: Axial Displacement
AxialDisplacement.description: Net axial movement of the sample (or load) from its initial position, accounting for both piston displacement and any sample compression.

ProppantCompressionDisplacementCorrectio.title: Proppant Compression Displacement Correction
ProppantCompressionDisplacementCorrectio.description: Incremental correction applied to the measured axial displacement to account for the compressibility of a pure (unconsolidated) proppant pack

EmbedmentDepth.title: Embedment Depth
EmbedmentDepth.description: Depth of proppant indentation measured at the applied stress

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description: Array object capturing remarks or additional information for this test step.  Remarks for the analysis as a whole should be captured in the associated SamplesAnalysis work product component.

items.title: AbstractRemark
items.description: A remark object, pairing a remark text with a source, e.g. an author, and a date, which is typically included in an array. The RemarkSequenceNumber acts as unique key in this case.

RemarkSequenceNumber.title: Remark Sequence Number
RemarkSequenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for each remark record. This identifier is used to uniquely identify a member in an array of remarks.

Remark.title: Remark
Remark.description: A descriptive comment for this remark.

RemarkSource.title: Remark Source
RemarkSource.description: The person, vendor, interpreter or other provider of information.

RemarkDate.title: Remark Date
RemarkDate.description: The date the remark was issued.
